description: React component for a custom table header in an Ag-Grid table, including sorting, filtering, and menu controls.

classes.name: CustomHeader
classes.description: React functional component for custom table header with sorting and filtering controls.

methods.name: getSortIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate sort icon based on sort state.

methods.name: autoOpenFilterAndFocus
methods.description: Automatically opens filter popover and focuses input after server-side filtering.

methods.name: clearSort
methods.description: Clears the current sort on the column.

methods.name: applySort
methods.description: Applies ascending or descending sort to the column.

methods.name: getNextSortDirection
methods.description: Determines the next sort direction based on current state.

methods.name: toggleSort
methods.description: Toggles the sort state between ascending, descending, and none.

methods.name: handleFilterClick
methods.description: Handles click event to toggle filter popover.

methods.name: handleMenuClick
methods.description: Handles click event to toggle menu popover.
